name: Psywall
author: Dragos Robu
description: Your wallpaper and your Philips Hue lights, moving to whatever's playing. A subtle oil-slick tint flows through the dark parts of the wallpaper, and up to 10 Hue lights stream 50 times a second, passing the beat around the room instead of pulsing together. Pair the bridge, pick your lights and drag each one to where it stands, all from the bar.

barWidget.description: A live miniature of your Hue lights; click for the room map, the show, Hue setup and controls
